references.text: Jesus uses the same metaphor of day and night as a time limit for doing God's will, warning that when night comes, no one can work.
Jesus urges his disciples to walk in the light while they have it, before darkness (night) comes, and warns that whoever walks in the dark does not know where they are going.
Jesus identifies himself as the light coming into the world, so that no one who believes in him should remain in the dark, emphasizing the urgency to act while the light is present.
Paul urges believers to wake up from sleep, for now salvation is nearer than when they first believed; the day has come, and night is passing away.
Paul describes believers as children of light and of the day, urging them to wake up and put on the armor of light, in contrast to those who belong to night and darkness.
